lifecycle.initialize: Create one session after explicit user connection and peer approval.
lifecycle.reset: Disconnect cancels pending input and requires a new session.
lifecycle.close: Closing the tab closes its session and stops output delivery.
lifecycle.isolation: Input, output and working state belong to one tab only.

interaction.surface: The terminal canvas receives keyboard input directly.

actions.trigger: Type on the terminal canvas and press Enter.
actions.expected: Input reaches the same remote shell and its response is rendered.

actions.trigger: Press Ctrl+C during an active command.
actions.expected: The interrupt byte reaches the active session; the connection stays open.
The active peer receives the new row and column dimensions.

protocol.name: SSH PTY plus shell channel
protocol.negotiation: Await peer approval of PTY and shell requests before accepting input.
protocol.framing: Preserve ordered UTF-8 and terminal control bytes without inserting local echo.
protocol.ordering: Keep one shell across commands; never substitute an independent exec per key or command.

persistence.retained: Explicitly saved host, account and viewport preferences.
persistence.excluded: Passwords, pending keys and authenticated live sessions are not saved automatically.
persistence.restart: Restore saved metadata; require fresh authentication and an empty input queue.

cases.trigger: The peer rejects the shell request.
cases.expected: Show the actual rejection and keep terminal input disabled.
cases.recovery: Allow explicit retry or disconnect without replaying stale input.

steps.action: Open and approve a synthetic peer; focus the terminal canvas.
steps.expected: PTY/shell acknowledgements occur before input is enabled.

steps.action: Change directory, then type a directory query; resize and send Ctrl+C.
steps.expected: The same shell retains its directory, receives dimensions and interrupt; a second tab is unaffected.

steps.action: Queue input, disconnect, reconnect, then close the tab.
steps.expected: No old input replays; output stops for the closed session.

scenarios.title: Retain metadata without credentials or live state

steps.action: Save synthetic metadata, terminate and reopen the application.
steps.expected: Metadata returns, while passwords, pending keys and authenticated sessions do not.

scenarios.title: Rejected shell remains disconnected from terminal input

steps.action: Connect to a synthetic peer rejecting the shell request, then retry.
steps.expected: The rejection is visible, no keys are sent before readiness, and retry does not replay old input.

scenarios.title: Type directly on the terminal canvas

steps.action: Connect to a synthetic peer, click the terminal canvas, type a marker and press Enter without using a separate command field.
steps.expected: The focused terminal sends input and renders the peer response in that canvas.

steps.action: Press Ctrl+C and resize the visible viewport.
steps.expected: The same connected session receives the interrupt and new dimensions; typing continues in the focused canvas.

claims.subject: protocol.mode
claims.statement: The target uses a continuous interactive shell.
claims.rationale: Authored example requirement; no original runtime evidence is supplied.
